title: Edit Workflow — wire edit button + route from detail page
description:
The WorkflowBuilder already supports edit mode (loads via useWorkflow when ID present), but there's no Edit button on WorkflowDetailPage to navigate to it.

Changes:
1. Add "Edit Workflow" button to WorkflowDetailPage header (next to Run Now)
2. Button navigates to `/workflows/:id/edit` (or reuses `/workflows/new` with ID param)
3. Add route in App.tsx: `/workflows/:id/edit` → WorkflowCreatePage (which renders WorkflowBuilder)
4. WorkflowBuilder already detects edit mode via `isEdit = !!workflowId && workflowId !== 'new'`
5. After save in edit mode: navigate back to `/workflows/:id` detail page
6. Add edit icon button on WorkflowTemplateCard (small pencil icon, top-right)
definitionOfDone: Edit Workflow button visible on WorkflowDetailPage
Clicking navigates to builder with workflow pre-loaded
Edit icon on WorkflowTemplateCard in templates list

implementationPlan.description:
Add edit route in `App.tsx`: `/workflows/:id/edit` pointing to `WorkflowCreatePage`. The existing WorkflowBuilder inside WorkflowCreatePage already detects edit mode via `useParams` when `id !== 'new'`.

In WorkflowBuilder: after successful save in edit mode, `navigate(`/workflows/${workflowId}`)` instead of `/workflows`.

Add "Edit Workflow" button to WorkflowDetailPage header, next to the Run Now button. Uses `navigate(`/workflows/${id}/edit`)`. Icon: Pencil from lucide-react, variant=outline.

Add small pencil icon button to WorkflowTemplateCard (top-right corner, `e.stopPropagation()` to prevent card navigation). Navigates to `/workflows/${workflow.id}/edit`.

SECURITY: Navigation uses validated workflow ID from API response, no user-controlled URL construction.

Verify `node ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit`.
